title: docs: grammatical errors, incorrect articles, and self-referencing SEE ALSO link in man pages
body:
### Description

There are several grammatical errors, incorrect indefinite articles, and an incorrect self-reference across the documentation man pages in the `docs/` directory:

1. **`docs/buildah-umount.1.md`**:
   - Line 27: In `## SEE ALSO`, `buildah-umount(1)` links circularly to itself (`buildah(1), buildah-umount(1), buildah-unshare(1)`) instead of linking to the counterpart `buildah-mount(1)`.

2. **`docs/buildah-manifest-exists.1.md`**:
   - Line 31: `"Check if an manifest called 'mylist' exists..."` contains an incorrect indefinite article (`an manifest` → `a manifest`).

3. **`docs/buildah-build.1.md`**:
   - Line 1283: `"...path to an user namespace which is already in use..."` contains an incorrect indefinite article (`an user` → `a user`).
   - Line 1581: `"### Building an multi-architecture image using the --manifest option..."` contains an incorrect article (`an multi-architecture` → `a multi-architecture`).

4. **`docs/buildah-from.1.md`**:
   - Line 473: `"...path to an user namespace which is already in use..."` contains an incorrect indefinite article (`an user` → `a user`).

5. **`docs/buildah-commit.1.md`**:
   - Line 431: `"### Building an multi-architecture image using the --manifest option..."` contains an incorrect article (`an multi-architecture` → `a multi-architecture`).

6. **`docs/buildah-mount.1.md`**:
   - Line 24: `"On error an empty string and errno is returned."` has a subject-verb agreement issue with a compound subject (`is returned` → `are returned`).

7. **`docs/buildah.1.md`**:
   - Line 97: `"Storage driver option, Default..."` contains a comma splice (`option, Default` → `option. Default`), and `"The --storage-opt specified options overrides all"` has a subject-verb agreement mismatch (`options overrides` → `options override`).

### Steps to Reproduce
Inspect the referenced man pages in `docs/`.

### Expected Results
Man pages and documentation are grammatically sound, reference appropriate complementary commands, and use correct article and agreement rules.

### Actual Results
Typos, incorrect articles (`an manifest`, `an user`, `an multi-architecture`), compound subject mismatch (`is returned`), and a circular `SEE ALSO` self-reference (`buildah-umount` referencing `buildah-umount`) are present.
